_note: US dollars to the euro: the ECB's reference rate of `date`, read by hand on `read` (Banca d'Italia's page for that day gives the same 1.1165). The ECB publishes it for information only, so a shop and a card convert at their own rates. Only the euro figures in fab/order/ use it: sprue handoff writes them with it, and sprue status, score, package and all read it when they check that folder is current. The quote stays in USD and does not read it. Changing it makes fab/order/ out of date (run sprue handoff again), and a file Sprue can't use takes fab/order/ away. It is not part of the gates' code, so faults.json stays current.
